entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
Hi, David. I... I need to make a return. I just got my order a little while ago.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. It's for the new Aero-Flow helmet. I was so excited for it.
Okay, I see the order. It was delivered nine days ago. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it's just... it's the color. On the website, it looked like a bright, happy yellow, but in person, it's more of a mustard. It's just not what I imagined. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it.
I've been a VeloFit customer for years, I buy all my gear here. I just... I really needed this money back for some other things coming up. I feel bad about returning it.

I completely understand, and there's no need to feel bad. It's disappointing when the color isn't quite what you were expecting. The most important thing is your safety, of course, but we absolutely want you to feel great about the gear you're wearing.
Since it's a standard helmet and you're unfortunately outside our 10-day return policy, processing this return is no problem at all.

Absolutely. And I can see you're a VIP member with us, Maria. We really appreciate your loyalty. As a thank you, I've gone ahead and processed this with a complimentary return shipping label, so you won't have to pay to send it back. I've just sent that to your email on file.
Wow. That... that's really kind of you. I was worried it would be a whole process.
Not at all. Once we receive the helmet, you'll see a full refund back to your original payment method in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's perfect. Thank you so much, David. You've really made my day.
You're very welcome, Maria. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
